Both pathways converge on the EDD domain protein as a central mediator, indicating a possible role in the interaction between Cornusalterin F and the Prostaglandin D2 receptor. The evidence supports a mechanism where Cornusalterin F exerts its biological effects through the EDD domain protein, which acts as a bridge to the Prostaglandin D2 receptor. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as both pathways have similar scores, suggesting a consistent but not necessarily exclusive relationship. The exact nature of the interaction, including the specific molecular mechanisms and the role of the EDD domain protein, remains to be fully elucidated.
